articles.headline: Infotrak July 2026 Poll: President Ruto Leads at 32% as Opposition Bloc Fragmented Across 4 Tickets
articles.summary: Latest national survey (n=3,000 ±1.79%) shows President Ruto leading at 32%, Kalonzo at 19%, Matiang'i at 14%, and Gachagua at 11%. 15% remain undecided.

articles.headline: Mt Kenya Electoral Matrix Shifts: Gachagua Faction Consolidates Regional Base While UDA Launches Counter-Drive
articles.summary: Vernacular radio monitoring in Nyeri, Kiambu, and Murang'a shows intense narrative competition between impeached DP loyalists and UDA development envoys.

articles.headline: ABC Coalition Speculation Mounts as Kalonzo, Matiang'i, and Gachagua Factions Hold Consultative Talks
articles.summary: Opposition strategists explore joint anti-Ruto platform ahead of 2027. Combined projections indicate over 44% initial vote share if single ticket is agreed.

articles.headline: IEBC 2026 Voter Registration Drive Adds 2.6M Youth Voters; #NikoKadi Campaign Trends Nationally
articles.summary: Youth voter registration reaches record levels in Nairobi, Mombasa, and Nakuru. UDA strategy team activates Ghost-Hunter identification program.

articles.headline: Western Kenya Swing Region Heats Up as Mudavadi and Wetang'ula Anchor UDA Expansion in Bungoma & Kakamega
articles.summary: Projections show UDA gaining ground in Western (20% -> 26%), with flagship regional infrastructure projects set for Q4 groundbreaking.

articles.headline: TIFA May vs Infotrak July Polling Trends: Ruto Bounces Back from 24% to 32% Nationally Following Hustler Fund Phase 3
articles.summary: Comparative polling trends show presidential approval stabilizing following Hustler Fund Phase 3 rollouts and regional infrastructure pledges.

articles.headline: Rift Valley Voter Registration Drive Launched to Counter Turnout Decay in Stronghold Wards
articles.summary: UDA field network dispatches 500 mobile registration caravans across Bomet, Kericho, and Elgeyo-Marakwet to lock first-time voters.

articles.headline: Broad-Based Government Deliverables Factsheet Released to Address Public Sector Reform Concerns
articles.summary: Government policy team publishes comprehensive factsheet on civil service salary adjustments and SHA healthcare implementation milestones.
